images.title: The six-pointed star
images.purpose: Show a regular hexagon GHIJKL with its sides extended to form a six-pointed star.
images.composition: One star centred in the frame, the hexagon at its middle.
exact_structure: A regular hexagon in the middle with corners labelled G, H, I, J, K and L in order.
Each side of the hexagon extended both ways as thin dark lines, so that 6 triangular points form outside the hexagon.
The hexagon is shaded teal (#0072B2); the 6 point triangles are shaded amber (#E69F00).
The point triangle on side GH has its tip labelled A.

At G, the hexagon angle carries a reddish purple (#CC79A7) angle arc labelled 120°, and the angle next to it on the straight line, inside triangle AGH, carries a green (#009E73) angle arc labelled 60°.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: 180° − 120° = 60°, so each point of the star is an equilateral triangle.
images.description: Show a regular hexagon GHIJKL with its sides extended to form a six-pointed star.
images.context: Shown beside the concept text and video for this concept.

image_decisions.why: The angle next to the 120° hexagon angle must be seen on the extended side.
